intro: When your space needs more than a bed, Glory steps up. With soft LED lighting, display shelves, and smart storage, it helps you stay organised without losing the luxe.

features.title: Lighting that suits every mood
features.text: Whether you're winding down after a long day or need a soft glow for late-night reading, the LED headboard light with dimmer helps you create the perfect ambience.

features.title: Keep it close, keep it tidy
features.text: The built-in ledge-style display gives you a sleek, practical spot to keep your bedtime must-haves — from books and glasses to your phone and favourite mug.

features.title: Smart storage, tucked out of sight
features.text: The lift-up box storage beneath your bed offers a simple, spacious solution for keeping extra linen, cushions or anything else neatly stowed away. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Soft, supportive, and made for comfort
features.text: Our cushioned headboard offers a plush place to lean back and relax — whether you're reading, scrolling, or enjoying your morning brew.

features.title: A tall headboard that brings elegance home
features.text: Bold in height and refined in style, the grand headboard serves as both a visual anchor and a daily comfort, offering support when you need it most.

name: Upmods Glory Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
